In the figure above, $∠SOT$ is a straight angle. Find $m∠TOV.$
question.worked_solution:
Since $∠SOT$ is straight, $m∠SOT={180}^{∘}.$ So by the angle addition postulate, we have

$$
m∠SOU+m∠UOT={180}^{∘}.
$$

Substituting the given expressions into the above, we can solve for $w$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}(2z+{60}^{∘})+(3z+{10}^{∘}) & ={180}^{∘} \\ 5z+{70}^{∘} & ={180}^{∘} \\ 5z & ={110}^{∘} \\ z & ={22}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that we know $z={22}^{∘},$ we can calculate $m∠SOU$ as follows:

$$
m∠SOU=2({22}^{∘})+{60}^{∘}={104}^{∘}
$$

Finally, since the angles $∠SOU$ and $∠TOV$ are vertical angles, they have the same measure:

$$
m∠TOV=m∠SOU={104}^{∘}
$$
